name: Puri Diplomatic Greens
shortDescription: Puri Diplomatic Greens is a premium ready-to-move residential community by Puri Constructions, located in Sector 111, Gurgaon, along Dwarka Expressway.
longDescription:
Puri Diplomatic Greens is an established luxury residential project in Sector 111, Gurugram, strategically positioned along the Dwarka Expressway near the Delhi-Gurgaon border. Developed by Puri Constructions, the project is spread across approximately 20 acres and offers spacious 3 & 4 BHK apartments along with exclusive luxury villas. The project is ready to move and features landscaped open spaces, a premium clubhouse, swimming pool, sports facilities, security and other lifestyle amenities.

Its location provides convenient access to Dwarka, Delhi, IGI Airport, Palam Vihar, NH-48 and key commercial destinations of Gurugram. The project is particularly suited for buyers looking for spacious luxury residences with strong Delhi-NCR connectivity.
